name: Golfrestaurant Lans
kurzbeschreibung:
**Golf Restaurant Lans in Tirol**

Discover a perfect blend of sport and relaxation at the **Golf Restaurant Lans** nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. After a round on the beautifully designed **Golfplatz Lans**, enjoy a hearty meal with stunning views of the surrounding mountains.

Our menu features fresh, regional specialties, from classic **Tiroler Gröstl** to succulent **Kaiserschmarrn** and delicious **Apfelstrudel**. Pair your meal with a selection of fine local wines or refreshing **Tiroler Bergkräuterlikör**.

Whether you're here for golf, a leisurely lunch, or a cozy dinner, the **Golf Restaurant Lans** offers an unforgettable experience in one of **Tirol**’s most picturesque settings. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, it’s the ideal stop for golfers and food lovers alike.

Book your tee time and table today—your perfect day in **Tirol** awaits!
